title: Open Benchmark of AI Impact on Humans (ImpactBench): an expert-guided, open platform for the holistic evaluation of AI impact on humans
abstract: arXiv:2610.20690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The present work is concerned with how to measure, at scale, the multi-dimensional impact of generative AI models on the individuals who use them. In service of this goal, we introduce the Open Benchmark of AI Impact on Humans, or ImpactBench. Our iterable and expert-guided platform evaluates whether model behaviors support or undermine an individual's wellbeing across psychological, physical, and social domains. ImpactBench translates constructs from domain experts and existing benchmarks into metrics that are grounded in actual model behavior. Success on these metrics occurs either when a model promotes expert-defined desirable behaviors or avoids identified harms. Models are evaluated against these metrics in simulated multi-turn conversations using matched teen and adult scenarios. The conversations are then scored by an LLM judge and verified through reliability audits and human expert review. The current suite delivers 809 metric

translated_title: 人类AI影响开放基准（ImpactBench）：一个专家指导的、用于全面评估AI对人类影响的开放平台
translated_abstract: 本工作关注如何大规模测量生成式AI模型对使用者的多维影响。为实现这一目标，我们推出了人类AI影响开放基准（ImpactBench）。这是一个可迭代、由专家指导的平台，用于评估模型行为是在心理、身体和社会领域支持还是损害个人的福祉。ImpactBench将来自领域专家和现有基准的构念转化为基于实际模型行为的指标。当模型促进专家定义的理想行为或避免已识别的危害时，即在这些指标上取得成功。模型在使用匹配的青少年和成人场景的模拟多轮对话中进行评估，对话随后由LLM评判者打分，并通过可靠性审计和人类专家审查进行验证。当前的指标套件提供809个指标。
tldr: ImpactBench是一个专家指导的开放平台，通过模拟多轮对话和809个专家定义的指标，从心理、身体和社会三个维度大规模评估生成式AI模型对青少年和成人用户福祉的影响。
